transcript.speaker: Deal Witness
transcript.text: The funding model carries the budget and the engineering package mentions certification, but the remembered trail does not yet tie both actions to the first construction draw.

transcript.speaker: Deal Witness
transcript.text: Ada Rook ranks first because ER-119 identifies her as independent-engineering director. Ren Ito can approve wording; Talia Wren supports the amount. Historical Maya edges explain the route, but Maya is not contacted.

transcript.speaker: Deal Witness
transcript.text: FS-044 carries the mitigation budget, ER-119 identifies independent certification, and MK-207 contains the approved condition. Before the first construction draw, who must do what, and which receipts establish both parts?

transcript.speaker: Ada Rook
transcript.text: It was handled in the engineering package; the draw should be okay.

transcript.speaker: Deal Witness
transcript.text: I cannot close the gap from “should be okay.” Please state the actor, action, timing, certification, and approved source citations in one sentence.

transcript.speaker: Ada Rook
transcript.text: Before the first construction draw, sponsor deposits the noise-mitigation budget and an independent engineer certifies it is fully funded. ER-119 page 4 is my certification basis, FS-044 line 18 is the approved budget, and MK-207 §4.2(b) is the committee-approved condition.

transcript.speaker: Ren Ito
transcript.text: Source-0429 is the approved committee record: deposit and independent certification are required before lenders release the first construction draw.

transcript.speaker: EverOS
transcript.text: Source-0430 preserves Ada's substantive answer, Ren's approved record, the cited receipts, Maya's historical navigation edge, and a reusable investigation recipe. It is a replay of preloaded metadata, not a shown live write.

steps.title: Maya is already gone. The deal closes Friday.
steps.narration: Nine months. Fourteen organizations. Thirty-six people. Her institution-owned work routes remain; her judgment is not cloned.

steps.title: 430 records flow in
steps.narration: Synthetic Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, email, SharePoint, models, and documents replay from fixture metadata—not live connectors.
steps.historicalStatus: Every route stays attached to a receipt

steps.title: A navigable memory takes shape
steps.narration: 288 items compress into 13 stable clusters and 24 investigation paths.
steps.historicalStatus: Financial, technical, legal, and stakeholder routes remain navigable

steps.title: Eight paths are still hollow
steps.narration: Maya's historical edges route the search. They do not prove the answer.

steps.title: Who should know?
steps.narration: One of 144 contract-scoped items opens. Ada can certify; Ren can approve.
steps.exampleKicker: Selected for demo · one representative of 144 contract-scoped items

steps.title: Vague is not enough

steps.title: Ada supplies the source
steps.narration: Her answer names actor, action, timing, certification, and citation. Approval is still required.

steps.title: EverOS preserves the completed path

steps.historicalStatus: Maya's historical contribution remains visible after departure

steps.title: The memory catches an omission

steps.historicalStatus: Historical route + approved evidence remain available without Maya
